title: Bouguer gravity maps of the Graniteville and Trenton 7.5-minute quadrangles and gravity station data
citation: Lawrence, D.P., 1992, Bouguer gravity maps of the Graniteville and Trenton 7.5-minute quadrangles and gravity station data: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-70, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: SCGS OFR-70 (Lawrence, 1992), simple Bouguer gravity maps of the Graniteville and Trenton 7.5-minute quadrangles (two sheets): one-milligal gravity contours and numbered gravity stations on topographic bases (Bouguer density 2.67, I.G.F. subtracted). The gravity station data named in the title are not legible as a table in the packet text. No geologic units, structures, drill holes or geologic surfaces; gravity values are geophysical and do not fit the schema, so nothing is recorded (same treatment as other Bouguer maps). SUBSURFACE: none.
